versos.e: Meets with the disciples after the Lord’s ascension Ac 1:13
Finds Peter, his brother, and brings him to Jesus Joh 1:40-42
Reports the number of loaves at the feeding of the five thousand Joh 6:8
Tells Jesus of the Greeks who sought to see him Joh 12:20-22
His name appears in the list of the apostles in Mt 10:2; Mr 3:18; Lu 6:14
Asks the Master privately about the destruction of the temple Mr 13:3,4
